archetypes.framing: These are evidence-informed engineering work-style archetypes, not fixed personality labels or performance ratings.

primary.title: The Strategist
primary.description: Resourceful and deliberate. Foxes frame ambiguity, see options early and choose a path with intent.

avatar.label: Guide
avatar.description: Demonstrating broad, consistent practice in complex contexts.
avatar.visual: A radiant laurel crest that signals a mature, evidence-backed practice.

secondary.title: The Adapter
secondary.description: Flexible and quick to learn. Chameleons adapt tools and approaches to fit the real context.
secondary.strengths: Finds a useful approach when the context changes.

avatar.label: Practitioner
avatar.description: Showing a repeatable practice across real engineering work.
avatar.visual: A practical compass badge that signals reliable craft.

very.title: The Investigator
very.description: Observant and methodical. Owls gather context, compare signals and resist the first plausible answer.

very.title: The Architect
very.description: Structured and patient. Spiders design strong foundations and make complexity easier to navigate.
very.strengths: Designs patterns that hold as a system grows.

okay.title: The Focused Operator
okay.description: Clear-eyed and decisive. Hawks identify the highest-value next move and finish what matters.
